thread:
alice.m: Heads up — we need a short design decision: migrating from project-scoped API keys to token-bound service accounts (TB-SAs) that carry route-level quotas. Main concerns: attribution for billing, gradual rollout UX in console, and telemetry gaps for debugging quota hits.

ben_r: Why force token-bound SAs vs keeping project keys + add metadata? More friction for customers.

cory_p: TB-SAs let us enforce least-privilege per-route and avoid noisy shared keys. Also enables easier fallback routing (e.g., route->cheap-model fallback when high cost). Migration friction is real tho.

alice.m: Exactly. Proposal: default to project keys for now but allow customers to opt into TB-SA per org; we surface migration status in console and provide a canary toggle.

diana-ui: For console UX, I want a single line item per org: "Auth migration status: Legacy keys / Mixed / TB-SA only". Clicking expands to show mapping (project -> SA) and rollout toggle. Minimal copy and clear recommended action.

cory_p: Telemetry-wise we need two things: 1) attribution — map incoming requests to effective identity (original key, exchanged SA, route). 2) sampling traces (token, model, route, latency, cost). Without mapping we can't show bill impact or SLO regressions.

alice.m: +1. Example of the attribution query I sketched (pseudo):
```sql
SELECT org_id, route, effective_identity, sum(tokens) AS tokens_used, count(1) AS reqs
FROM inference.requests_sampled
WHERE ts BETWEEN now()-interval '1d' AND now()
GROUP BY 1,2,3
ORDER BY tokens_used DESC
LIMIT 200;
```
Use this to populate per-org "migration impact" card.

ben_r: How do we handle billing when a request starts with legacy project key but later gets exchanged to a TB-SA (impersonation/impersonation header)? We need deterministic attribution for billing.

cory_p: We already pass an origin header when we exchange tokens. Suggest we canonicalize attribution to the earliest upstream identity unless customer opts into "bill-by-effective-identity". Add a flag in org settings.

diana-ui: If there's a customer-facing flag, show a tooltip: "Controls whether usage is billed to the original project key or to the service account used after exchange." Keep it off by default.

alice.m: Rollout plan idea: 1) telemetry-only phase (show migration impact card, no enforcement), 2) opt-in TB-SA enforcement per org, 3) soft-enforce (warnings + telemetry), 4) mandatory after X months. We should add a canary where we enable enforcement for a small % of production traffic in an org.

cory_p: Technical detail: need to wire sampling at the gateway before exchange so we record original key; then enrich trace after exchange with SA id. Otherwise we lose mapping.

ben_r: Any perf hit? Gateway sampling will add headers and a tiny lookup. We should WL it and measure.

eve-bot: ALERT: observed spike in quota-denied events for route /v1/embeddings in sandbox-org-42 — +420% in last 2h. sample_ids: ["req_az12","req_bz34","req_cy56"].

alice.m: Thanks @eve-bot — that's exactly why early telemetry phase matters. Cory, can we surface top failing orgs on the migration card and link to raw logs?

cory_p: Yes. We'll add a "Top quota denies" widget with direct jump to logs and the sampled SQL above. Also emit an event when a legacy-key->TB-SA exchange occurs so billing team can reconcile.

diana-ui: For the canary toggle in console: show rollout percentage slider (0-100), default 0, show expected number of affected requests based on sampled history. Tooltip: "Use canary to enable enforcement incrementally."

alice.m: Action items: 
- Cory: add exchange-event telemetry + gateway pre-exchange sampling (owner: eng-runtime)
- Diana: mockups for migration card + canary slider + migration status line (owner: devex/console)
- Ben: run perf baseline for gateway sampling (owner: eng-platform)
- Me: coordinate a short doc for CS explaining opt-in vs default billing behaviors (owner: product)

ben_r: I'll start perf test today. rough estimate: +0.5-2% p99 cost, but will validate.

deploy-bot: deploy-status: infra/gateway sampling patch rolled to canary (2 hosts) — 1759999200 success :white_check_mark:

alice.m: Nice. Let's sync Friday 11am to review mockups + first telemetry signals. :thumbsup:

cory_p: I'll post initial telemetry dashboard link when ready.

ben_r: FYI I'll attach perf numbers in the thread once I have them.
